periods.time: vol-15 ch-002, night before the representative war

name.zh: 纳西姆击溃联盟国境军
name.en: Naseem routs the League border army

periods.summary: Naseem single-handedly defeats the League assault force, kills Carlo Bertoni, and prevents the League from interfering with the Vermillion-Quedland representative war.
periods.cause: The League masses a million-strong encirclement and a thirty-thousand elite assault force near Quedland so it can invade if Vermillion loses; Or-Gaule's side sends Naseem to push them back before the duel.
periods.process: Naseem appears as an envoy and demands withdrawal. Dargus stalls and orders a tank barrage, seemingly blowing him apart, but Naseem reforms from black sand. He ignores bullets, creates guns from earth, and slaughters the advance troops. Mage-Knights surround him, but Mictlan Tormenta dries them into dust and routs the line. Carlo Bertoni arrives, creates the Eighth Sea in the sky, and nearly overwhelms Naseem with underwater speed, ice spears and a heart thrust. Naseem drinks the Eighth Sea dry, endures mortal wounds through sheer monstrous will, crushes Carlo's head, and collapses the ground into quicksand as the army flees.
periods.outcome: Carlo dies, Dargus orders retreat, the League assault force is devastated and roughly a quarter of the overall prepared force is lost or neutralized around the front.
periods.aftermath: Or-Gaule congratulates Naseem; Naseem makes clear he fought mainly to keep anyone from interrupting his coming match with Nene. Stella later prays for the dead and steels herself against Naseem's terror.
casualties: large numbers of League soldiers and Mage-Knights killed or buried
periods.significance: Removes the League's direct military backup, demonstrates the disaster scale of a Desperado, and isolates the representative war as Vermillion's only immediate path.
